test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

They are watching the match live.

options.text: The match is being watched live.
The match has been watched live.
The match was being watched live.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They are watching the match live."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the match" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "are watching" to "is being watched" (present continuous passive).
 
• The subject "They" becomes "by them," but it is often omitted in passive sentences when the doer is obvious or less important than the action itself (as reflected in the options).
 
• Ensure the adverb "live" remains at the end of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The match is being watched live."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The match is watched live." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The match has been watched live." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The match was being watched live." – Incorrect tense (past continuous passive).
